name: Jura
flagName: Flag of the Canton of Jura
summary: Divided vertically: a red crozier on white at the hoist, and seven red and white stripes at the fly. Jura is Switzerland's newest canton, created in 1979.
origin: The northern French-speaking part of the canton of Bern voted to secede in 1974 after a long separatist struggle. The canton of Jura was established on 1 January 1979. The crozier recalls the Prince-Bishopric of Basel, which once ruled the area.

symbols.name: Seven stripes
symbols.description: Three red and four white stripes.
symbols.meaning: The seven districts of the historic Jura region.

facts: It is the newest Swiss canton, created in 1979.
Its seven stripes include districts that remained in Bern.
clues: A red bishop's staff beside seven red and white stripes.
It seceded from a larger canton after a referendum.
